description: This Java source file defines the SecurePayPaymentServices class, providing methods for processing payments, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit operations via SecurePay API integration within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling SecurePay payment operations such as authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: doAuth
methods.description: Performs payment authorization via SecurePay, constructing transaction details, sending the request, and returning the authorization result.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Stub method for credit card re-authorization, currently returns success without implementation.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized payment, sending the capture request to SecurePay and returning the result.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a previously authorized transaction, communicating with SecurePay and returning the outcome.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured transaction through SecurePay, returning the result details.

methods.name: doCredit
methods.description: Issues a credit (refund or adjustment) to a credit card via SecurePay, returning the operation status.

methods.name: buildScProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for SecurePay API based on context and delegator, retrieving values from configuration entities or properties files.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values for SecurePay from database entities or properties files, with optional default fallback.
